subject: Northbeam AP: vendor enrollment, invoice routing and VAT fallback
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northbeam.health>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@northbeam.health>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment for Redwood — initial packet + questions

Hi Marta / Northbeam AP team,

Thanks again for the quick intro today. To get Redwood set up as a vendor in Northbeam so you can issue POs and pay invoices, I'm attaching our standard AP onboarding packet and a short checklist. Quick asks so we can align with your systems: 

- Remit address you require on the invoice (postal + electronic remit if different).
- PO reference format you expect on invoices (example: NB-PO-12345 or full-scan of the PO barcode/URN).
- Whether you accept UBL/PEPPOL e-invoices or require PDF invoices emailed to accounts-payable@northbeam.health.
- VAT/TIN evidence required for US entities or EU branches (if you need a specific tax form).
- Do you need us to register as a supplier in your portal (preferred), or will you create the vendor from our packet? If portal, please share the invite link and any character limits for legal name / tax id.

Attached: AP_Onboarding_Packet_Redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB).

If easier, looping in our finance lead Lauren (cc) and Ops (Aditya) so they can provide sample invoice templates and our TIN documentation. Expect a short follow-up from Lauren with a sample XML/URN example.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0179
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northbeam.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@northbeam.health>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northbeam.health>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment for Redwood — initial packet + questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks — receiving your packet now. A few notes and next steps from Northbeam AP: 

- Remit address: Northbeam Health, AP Dept, 420 Meridian Ave, Suite 200, Boston, MA 02111. For electronic payments please include: ACH to our lockbox (we'll provide banking token after vendor activation).
- PO reference: Please put the PO number on the invoice header as NB-PO-#####. We also support a secondary Invoice-URN field for automated matching; sample attached.
- E-invoicing: We currently accept both PDF emailed invoices and UBL via our Peppol endpoint but the PEPPOL route requires vendor registration + GL mapping. If you can support UBL, we'll prioritize automated matching; otherwise email PDF to accounts-payable@northbeam.health.
- Tax evidence: For US vendors we require W-9 (or W-8 for foreign entities). For EU entities we need VAT registration number and a copy of the VAT certificate.
- Portal: Please register at https://vendors.northbeam.health/register — we typically approve vendor records within 3 business days once the form and docs are uploaded. If you prefer, we can create the vendor from your packet; to do that we need a completed vendor form (attached) and a signed ACH mandate.

Attaching: northbeam_vendor_form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), sample-invoice-urn.xml (xml, 3KB).

I'll ask Oliver in Procurement to confirm the PEPPOL details if you plan to submit UBL.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Senior AP Manager — Northbeam Health
marta.ruiz@northbeam.health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northbeam.health>, Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@northbeam.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment for Redwood — initial packet + questions

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear checklist and the form. A couple clarifications from our finance team to make the onboarding smooth: 

1) Invoice identifiers: Our system can put both the PO number (NB-PO-#####) and a separate invoice URN. Attached is a sample-invoice-urn.xml and a PDF sample. Can you confirm which field your AP system consumes first for 3-way match (PO field vs URN)?

2) E-invoice fallback: We'll prioritize UBL on Peppol once vendor registration is complete. As an immediate fallback (first 30 days) we'll email invoices to accounts-payable@northbeam.health and include the URN in the subject line in this format: URN:RDW-20270916-INV-0001 so your parser can pick it up. Please confirm that your parser looks in the subject or invoice header.

3) Tax docs: Attached W-9 (redacted SSN on copy) and Redwood's EFT/ACH mandate. If Northbeam requires a signed vendor-specific mandate, please upload the DocuSign link and we'll sign.

Attachments from Redwood: W9_Redwood_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB); EFT_Mandate_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf, 80KB); sample-invoice-urn.pdf (application/pdf, 26KB).

If you prefer us to register through your portal, Ben will complete the vendor registration form and upload the docs by end of day.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0122

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northbeam.health>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@northbeam.health>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northbeam.health>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment for Redwood — initial packet + questions

Hi Lauren / Ben,

Perfect — thanks for the samples. Responses below: 

- Our matcher prefers the PO field first, then URN. If the PO matches, the invoice will auto-route; if only URN is present our team will route to manual queue unless the URN is paired with a recognized vendor token. Including URN in the subject will help automated intake — please use the URN: prefix as you suggested.
- We'll accept the emailed PDF fallback and will ingest the URN from the subject line. For long-term automation we'd recommend completing the Peppol vendor registration. Oliver will send the technical Peppol endpoint and mapping guide by tomorrow.
- We have received the W-9 and EFT mandate; our portal requires the signed DocuSign vendor ACH addendum for activation. I'll send the DocuSign link in a separate email (expect it within the hour).

Next steps (summary):
1) Ben to submit vendor registration on the portal or reply if you want Northbeam to create the vendor record from your packet.
2) Redwood to sign DocuSign ACH addendum when received.
3) Oliver to share Peppol endpoint + GL mapping and we can schedule a brief handoff call if needed.

I'll mark the vendor onboarding as high priority. Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Marta
